svg.title: Conventional coherent and reference-assisted energy-domain reception
svg.desc: Two receiver front ends with oblique, six-by-seven apertures and circuit symbols. The conventional receiver uses quadrature downconversion and filtering. The reference-assisted receiver combines the incident field with a common reference before element-wise square-law detection.
svg.text: High Hardware Complexity · Power Consumption · Cost
Physical-Domain Encoding · Simplified Acquisition · Computational Recovery
